title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-09
source: Matrix Recording From: Audience Lineage (shnid 91236): MR cassette > Nakamichi 550 > Lexicon Alpha > 48 Khz / 24-bit > USB > Samplitude 7.22 > 44.1 Khz /16-bit and SBD Lineage (shnid 172): S:MR > PCM > cassette > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN; pitch-corrected and matrixed by Monte Barry

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix capture of an all‑time great show featuring a jaw‑dropping Box of Rain vocal and a monster Truckin' jam.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this recording five stars, hailing it as one of the Dead’s greatest performances. The matrix blend is praised for its clarity and detail, with only a slight oddness in the mix between the snappy soundboard and delay‑tower echo, while Phil Lesh’s lead vocal on Box of Rain and the soaring Truckin' jam are singled out as highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently perfect scores and enthusiastic comments about both the musical performance and the matrix recording (despite minor mix quirks) indicate an exceptional show with excellent audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blend of snappy soundboard and delay‑tower echo is mostly clear and detailed; the juxtaposition can feel slightly weird at times but does not detract from overall listenability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Praised as an all‑time great show with strong energy throughout; set transitions flow well despite a minor set‑list description error.

band_member_comments.Phil: Lead vocal on Box of Rain described as jaw‑dropping
